slides.needs: dark gym at night, boxer sitting on bench head down, exhausted
slides.text: Here's exactly why you gas out in the first round...

slides.needs: boxer mid-punch on heavy bag, low light
slides.text: You hold your breath when you punch. Breathe out sharp on every shot.

slides.needs: boxer from behind in ring corner, shoulders relaxed
slides.text: You stay tense between exchanges. Loose shoulders save more energy than any cardio.
You throw every punch at 100%. Touch jabs set up the hard ones.

slides.needs: runner at dawn, fog, hoodie, from behind
slides.text: Your roadwork is all slow miles. Boxing is 3 hard minutes, 1 minute rest. Train that.
